phase: cut257 priority item 4: boundary clocks, per-cast identity and conservation
method: Controlled arenas and direct actual verbs/scheduler only. No charge is granted, no expected value is relaxed, and every negative names the real hit/Hurt/kill/debit it rests on. Fixed RNG seeds are shared by the enabled/disabled forks (a selected branch is component evidence, never earned play).

subItems.item: Rally's 10-tick history and Execution's 39/40-tick boundary (outside the shared 14-Combo expiry test)

tests.name: priority4_rally_tenth_tick_history_and_execution_fortieth_tick_boundary
tests.scene: Fighter [6]: bloat_mother at (5,5), bulwark_t=30, a real landed incoming melee blow writes last_block_t=turn; then real scheduler ticks to t+10 / t+11, hp=500, bash_cd=70, one legal second_wind. Fighter [9,11]: boss shield_bash arms Siege rhythm, bash_cd=70, a real ordinary attack kills a 1-hp boss at turn T (the charged kill), then fork, real ticks to T+39 / T+40, a fresh real boss bash and a real killing attack.
assertions: last_block_t == the real blow's turn
at 10 ticks: Applied BashCooldown == [20], bash_cd 70 -> 50
at 11 ticks: Applied BashCooldown == [] and bash_cd stays 70
the identical prefix with the node's own bit cleared (0x3f) still takes a legal wind and pays nothing (p2_no_receipt [6])
first charged kill: Applied BashCooldown == [20], bash_cd 50, execution_t == Some(T), the boss hp <= 0
kill at T+39: no new receipt, bash_cd stays 70, execution_t stays Some(T)
kill at T+40: Applied BashCooldown == [20,20], bash_cd 50, execution_t == Some(T+40), the boss hp <= 0
observed: priority4 rally elapsed=10 bash_cd=50 applied=[20] disabled_applied=[]
priority4 rally elapsed=11 bash_cd=70 applied=[] disabled_applied=[]
priority4 execution elapsed=39 paid=false bash_cd=70
priority4 execution elapsed=40 paid=true bash_cd=50

subItems.note: The kill is a real charged melee kill (Siege charge consumed, monster hp <= 0) both times, so the 39-tick negative is not a different action firing. A killed Bloat mother's burst moves the hero off the kill tile, so the boundary bash is aimed at the hero's actual position.

subItems.item: Retained Vanish 0/1/2/3 and shrinking repeated misses

tests.name: priority4_patient_ambush_retains_zero_through_three_and_shrinks_repeated_misses
tests.scene: Rogue [9]: non-kit sword (80% aim), vanish_t = 0/1/2/3/30, a real Ambush on the fixed seed that misses (seed 3 for the shared pair) or hits.
assertions: pre 0: the Ambush is refused (-act), the complete save is unchanged, no Applied Vanish
pre 1/2/3 on a real miss (Ev::Attack hit=false): vanish_t stays 1/2/3 and Applied Vanish == [pre] (3 is never invented)
the same fixed miss seed with the node cleared: the miss reproduces (hit=false) and vanish_t == 0 with no receipt
a real landed Ambush clears vanish_t to 0 with no Applied Vanish
three successive real misses retain 3 then 2 then 1 (shrinking, never refreshed)
each real tick decays vanish_cd by exactly 1 and vanish_t by 1 (no restoration, no new invulnerability)
at vanish_t 0 the Ambush is refused with an exact save and no receipt

subItems.item: old/new Ward, Slow, Aim and physical reload identities across a reload

tests.name: priority4_ward_slow_aim_and_reload_identities_survive_a_public_reload
tests.scene: (a) Caster [9,11] real ward. (b) Caster [6] real ward then real slow on a boss (the chilling charge). (c) Gunner [6] real aimed_shot then a real fire (the Rangefinder recovery). (d) Gunner [7,8] a real reload, a real smoke_retreat arming Smoke walk and the physical completion. Every case passes p1_canonical (one real observation tick + public Game::load).
assertions: the reload boundary is idempotent (Game::load(save).save() == save)
WardCast/AimCast/ReloadCast/SlowCast source+flags are byte-identical after the public reload
the reloaded ward shatters once (Consumed Ward [ward_t], Applied NovaCooldown [20]) and the spent cast cannot shatter again after the real Nova cooldown
a genuinely new ward cast has a different source, absorbed 0, both flags false, and shatters once
the reloaded original slow pays the chilling charge once (Applied WardCooldown [10]) and the spent cast cannot pay again; after the real slow runs out a new cast pays once more
the reloaded aim sequence (recovered=true) cannot recover again (loaded 0, no new Chamber receipt) and a new aim recovers once ([1,1])
the reloaded physical completion still happens (loaded 1), pays the refund once ([50]) and the reloaded and never-reloaded forks save byte-identically

subItems.item: Conservation: HP, Gold, physical chambers/capacity and normal cooldowns stay conserved when only energy or settlement is promised

tests.name: priority4_promised_energy_and_settlement_conserve_hp_loot_ammo_and_cooldowns
tests.scene: Five paired scenarios, each the same real verb sequence once with the tested node and once with only its bit cleared: rogue [8] smoke+shadowstep; ranger [9,11] volley+kite; gunner [11] close-burst kill+smoke_retreat; gunner [7] fast-reload+aim; gunner [6,7,10] the full long-watch prefix. Plus the gunner [8] reload+smoke+physical completion pair.
assertions: the conserved world (hp, run.loot gold, every monster hp, floor items + pack count, bash/vanish/double/ward/nova/blink/cleave cooldowns, gun fast/smoke/finish ready clocks, chamber load, firearm capacity, the physical reload identity, the turn) is identical with the node on and with its bit cleared
the cleared node emits no Applied output; the enabled one emits exactly one
energy nodes: Applied Energy [50] and energy == the cleared fork's energy + 50, always < ACT_ENERGY
settlement nodes: Applied AimSettle [1], energy strictly above the cleared fork and < ACT_ENERGY
the reload-completion refund's world (including the turn) is identical and the enabled fork never acts before the cleared fork (the extra energy is the real clock's own crossing)
